vadsrijk.z3.systemen.adv4.klaar: ✦ Level 50! You're ready for your fourth job advancement to %s! Go to the Nest Chapel in Honeybough.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.bord.jacht_uitleg: Take a contract and the target waits at its lair. Only for you and your party.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.bord.week: Weekly Goal: %s/%s bounties (then a Bounty Chest)
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.bord.week_klaar: Weekly Goal reached (%s/%s): your Bounty Chest is in!
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.bramzwijn_: A charge three wide, with bramble bushes.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.de_harsreu: A resin golem with three rings of shockwaves.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.de_stille_: Hears you sneaking. Unleashes three shadows.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.genomen: Contract taken! The target waits at its lair (check your map).
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.grootvader: Rolls across the field three times in a row.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.kapitein_k: Fires three cheeseballs in a fan.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.moeder_wes: Splits her swarm when she's at half health.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.niet_vanda: That target isn't on the board today.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.ouwe_rotke: An old rot boar that charges twice in a row.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.slangenkon: Wherever she surfaces, a puddle of sap is left behind.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.te_laag_lv: The Hunterguh only gives you contracts at level %s.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.verstopt: The target is hiding today. Try again later.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.contract.weg: %s ran off. You can take the contract again.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.al_geruild: You've already swapped today. Again tomorrow!
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.baas_hart: Defeat a boss in the Heart of the Tree
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.baas_kruin: Defeat a boss in The Canopy Sea
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.baas_werf: Defeat a boss of the Cheese Zeppelin Yard
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.elite_kruin: Defeat %s elites in the canopy or on the branches
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.elite_velden: Defeat %s elites in The Root Fields
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.geclaimd: Bounty claimed! Xp, coins and Hunt Tokens.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.geruild: Swapped! A new bounty on the board.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.jacht_kruinz: Defeat %s creatures in The Canopy Sea
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.jacht_velden: Defeat %s creatures in The Root Fields
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.klaar: ✦ Bounty done: %s! Collect your reward at the Bounty Board.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.rit_kort: Ride %s blocks on your mount through The Duskroot
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.rit_lang: Ride %s blocks on your mount through The Duskroot
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.te_laag: The Bounty Board opens at level 40.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.te_laag_lv: Come back at level %s: then the Hunterguh will have bounties for you.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.weekkist: ✦ Weekly Goal reached! There's a Bounty Chest in your bag.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.premie.wind: Get blown up by a wind column %s times
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.tip.adv4: At level 50 the Nest Chapel awaits: a new title and the Nest Form of your ult (same key, much bigger).
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.vahoeg.geen_zegel: You have no Wahoog Seal. The Hunterguh in Honeybough sells them for Hunt Tokens.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.vahoeg.te_laag: Wahoog mode only unlocks at level %s.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.al_goud: You already have the Golden Plumeguh! (%s feathers, %s needed)
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.erbij: ✦ +%s Golden Feather! You now have %s of %s.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.erbij_al: ✦ +%s Golden Feather! (%s; you already have the Golden Plumeguh, they're just nice and shiny.)
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.veer.te_weinig: You have %s of the %s Golden Feathers you need.
vadsrijk.z3.systemen.winkel.te_weinig: You don't have enough Hunt Tokens for that.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.ei: Colossus! Grab the egg! Grab the EGG!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.fase3.onder: Stand TOGETHER in the yellow circle by the egg
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.geblokt: Blocked! The Colossus's grabber arm can't reach the egg.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.gegrepen: The Colossus's grabber arm snatches at the egg! The Baron laughs and perks up.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.grijparm: The grabber arm reaches for the egg! Get together in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.intro: The Count is gone. So if I bring the egg myself... then I'll be the new Little Finger!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.kamer: Ripening Room! Out of the purple circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.spray: The Colossus sprays at a lantern! Relight it afterwards (right-click).
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.vlucht: The Emperor doesn't need to know about this! ...Right? (He escapes in his little zeppelin through a hole in the roots.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bb.zelf: Enough! Then I'll ripen you myself!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bleu: BARON BLEU AND THE MOLD COLOSSUS
vadsrijk.z3bazen.bleu.onder: The Count's Knuckle. Ripens everything. Even eggs.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.laden: The cannon is still loading... %s s
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.pantser: His armor plates soak up most of it: shoot them off with the deck cannons!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.plaat: An armor plate flies off! %s left.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.vlucht: Kaboom! ...No wait, that was me. I'm out of here!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.br.wielen: Cheese wheel bombs! Out of the red lanes!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.brokkel.onder: Cheese wheels, cannons and a whole lot of racket
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.floep: The gray mist swallows them up. Floop. Gone.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.onder: A cold, gray mist. It reaches everywhere.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.stilte: Silence. On the bark a gray, cold frost stain remains, where the mist came in.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f1.uitleggen: No no no, Emperor, I can explain! It was the knight! It was -
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.onder: Far in the east, something wants more and more.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.rapport1: Report from the west. The dragon is... uh... pink.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.rapport2: The egg has... uh... hatched. The Little Finger is... picked clean.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.rillen: A gray hall. Thin light. Count Squeakula kneels in his undershirt, shivering.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.f2.tik: From the shadow behind the throne comes impatient tapping on an armrest. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.bewogen: You moved in the dark! The roots can feel it...
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.kwekerij_open: All the mold kettles are off: the mold curtain falls away!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.ringen_open: The pink grain lines up: the tree rings slide open!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.slaapt: The roots are still asleep... Come back when Root Guard Glow sends you to the Heart (main story "The Heart of the Tree"). You can already fight, but your story only counts here once that quest is active.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.hart.welkom: The Heart of the Tree (lv 49-50). The root passage behind this gate climbs to the ring. There, past the Vein Run, the Mold Nursery and the Hall of Rings, the Root Strangler, the Old Nest Warden and Baron Bleu are waiting.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.imker.onder: The Emperor's spy. Beekeeper in name only.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.immuun: He's invulnerable right now: do the task first!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.achtervolg: The Canopy Raptor flees to another treetop! Call your mount and follow the pink trail of light. Get there fast and you get Wahoog!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.fase2.onder: Whoever he grabs, shoot them free!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.fase3.onder: He's fleeing! Follow the pink trail. Whistle for your Plumeguh: you can ride here!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.grijp: The Canopy Raptor dives at %s! Out of the purple circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.losgelaten: He drops you... you float gently back into the nest.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.losgeschoten: Hit! He lets go and tumbles for a moment.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.mis: Miss! His claws grab at thin air.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.verslagen: The Canopy Raptor falls apart into gray feathers that blow away over the canopy.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kr.wind: Wing Gust! He blows you toward the edge.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.kruinroofvogel.onder: He stole the old nest. And your lunch.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.loot.goud: %s has the GOLDEN PLUMEGUH! What a shine!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nestwachter.onder: He guards the egg. Against everyone.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.dank: ...Pink. I'm pink again. The gray is gone. Thank you, little knight.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.fase3.onder: Two waves in a row, they alternate
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.golf: Tree ring wave! Stand on a PINK ring!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.nw.splinter: Go on. The egg is waiting. And take this with you: I kept it warm for him. The little heart of his heart.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.au: Ow! Don't touch the cape! It's an antique!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.blaas: He blows at a lantern! Stand in the purple circle to protect the flame!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.donker: Fffffooo! There. Nice and dark. Nice and cold.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.enrage.onder: He loves the cold. You don't.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.fase2.onder: Break the cage locks: the mice are feeding his shield
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.fase3.onder: Light the lanterns again: only in the light can you hit him properly
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.grote_kooi: The big cage next to the throne is rattling! Right-click it open!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.intro: A knight? In MY Fur Hall? Squeak! Brrr, close the door, there's a draft.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.intro_weer: Still cold in here. That's because of YOU. Look, a new cape. Made of socks. Knitted. By me.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.kooi_open: A little cage springs open! The mice gnaw a hole in his cape. (%s of 4)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.mijn_cape: My cape! Do you know how many winters that took?!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.nee: No... no no no! Not the big cage! SQUEAK!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.nog_niet: The big cage is still locked. The Count needs to be weakened more first.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.schild: A chonk shield of mouse sorrow! Free the mice in the little cages!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.schild_op: Squeak squeak! My mice keep me warm. And safe.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.schild_weg.onder: And his cape is full of holes
vadsrijk.z3bazen.pv.zwier: Cape Swirl! Out of the red cone!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.roquefort.onder: Captain of the Cheese Zeppelin Fleet
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.ballonnen: Four balloon segments with purple marks: pop them and he sinks!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.ballonnen_eerst: His zeppelin keeps him up: pop the balloons first!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.kantel: The deck tilts! Loose crates slide down!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.matrozen: All hands on deck! Mika Deckhands!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.vlucht: This isn't over, knight! The Count will hear about this! (He floats away on his umbrella.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.rq.zinkt: The zeppelin is sinking! Jump to the wreck (pink circle)!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.fase2.onder: Shoot him or pull him down with a lever
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.gevallen: Crack! Taleggio falls down. Hit him now!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.hangt: Taleggio swings high on his ropes! Ranged attacks and magic hit him; pull a lever (pink) when he swings above it.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.klimt: Taleggio scrambles back up into the rigging.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.snij: Taleggio cuts the rigging loose! Out of the red, jump to the pink!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.te_ver: He isn't swinging above this lever. Wait until he's above it!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ta.vlucht: This is going in my report! I'm out of here! (He vanishes in a puff of smoke.)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.taleggio.onder: Everything on a string. You too.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.te_ver: You're outside the fight: you can't hit him from there!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.aderloop: When the heart beats, it goes dark. Stand still then!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.altaar: With a Wahoog Seal in your bag (from lv 50): right-click. The bosses get stronger and drop Golden Feathers.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.astrolabiumwachter: Hit him mostly when the rings line up (golden light): then your blow lands in full. During a ring sweep: stand in a pink opening.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.bleu: A burning lamppost burns the mold away: fight in the light. Yellow by the egg = stand in it TOGETHER.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.brokkel: His armor soaks up a lot. Right-click a deck cannon and look at him: that's how you shoot the plates off.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.donderbuik: Yellow circle: stand in it together and you share the thunderclap.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.glimmertje: He snuffs out the fire bowls. Right-click a dark bowl 2x to light it again. All four out? Then he hides in the dark.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.gorgonzola: Every closed valve makes him tougher and lets the cold in.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.grauwe_droom: Do the notes light up? Remember the order and right-click them the same way. Yellow circle: stand in it together and hum!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.imker: Red = move away. A swarm after you? Right-click a smoke pot and walk through the smoke. Is he pouring honey into the hive? Turn the hive (right-click) so its hole faces him!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.kanon: Right-click fires where you look. Only reloads faster.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ketel: Right-click burns it out (three times). Watch out for the purple spore cloud.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.kruinroofvogel: Red = his dive. Purple = he grabs or blows. Grabbed? Click or shift to break free. During his flight you may call your Plumeguh!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.lantaarnpaal: Right-click lights it. Light helps: in the dark you hit less.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.loods: Each lever turns two cannons a quarter turn. Aim all three at the gate!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.nestwachter: Tree-ring wave: stand on a PINK ring. Red = shoulder charge, step aside.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.piepvel: Free the mice: break the cage locks to break his shield. In the dark: light lanterns and fight in the light.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ringeling: Raid: everyone deals damage, roles are free. Fainted? You wake up on the stairs of this floor and can rejoin. If the whole group falls, the floor starts over.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ringen: Each button turns two tree rings a little. Line up the pink grain!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.roquefort: Red = his boarding attack. Purple = pop the balloons. Is the ship sinking? Jump to the pink wreck!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.spiegelvizier: Raid: everyone deals damage, roles are free. Fainted? You wake up on the stairs of this floor and can rejoin. If the whole group falls, the floor starts over.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ster_bultguh: Raid: everyone deals damage, roles are free. Fainted? You wake up on the stairs of this floor and can rejoin. If the whole group falls, the floor starts over.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.ster_pluis: Raid: everyone deals damage, roles are free. Fainted? You wake up on the stairs of this floor and can rejoin. If the whole group falls, the floor starts over.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.sterrenbeelden: Raid: everyone deals damage, roles are free. Fainted? You wake up on the stairs of this floor and can rejoin. If the whole group falls, the floor starts over.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.sterrenguh: Right-click the four telescopes until they all point at his heart (golden beam). Then he glows: double damage!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.taleggio: Red = that platform falls, pink = safe rigging. Is he hanging high? Pull a lever when he swings above it.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.vahoegnir: You don't defeat him: you cheer him up. Put the heart splinters back in the pink circle. Gray? Cheer up the bloblets. Yellow by the egg = together!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.vliegervanger: A Mika with a stolen plushie stash. Red = move away, purple = wind and winches, yellow = catch together.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.vliegervanger.titel: The Wreck of the Kite Catcher
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.wormelien: Keep moving when she burrows (standing still = sand fountain). Pink spots = take cover behind a dune. Phase 3: knock the gray salt crust off her back, jump from a dune or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.wortelwurger: His 4 feeding roots can only be hurt when the heart beats (it goes dark for a moment). Chop them through!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zandwachter: Raid: everyone deals damage, roles are free. Fainted? You wake up on the stairs of this floor and can rejoin. If the whole group falls, the floor starts over.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zeeslurf: You don't defeat him: you cheer him up. Follow the colors: red = move away, pink = safe, purple = the current, yellow = together.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zilverstaart: Is he escaping? Close the three gray gas valves (right-click, 3x).
vadsrijk.z3bazen.tip.zoutkolos: Red crack lines = salt waves. Hear a high note? Step out of the purple ring around a crystal, or smash it. Phase 3: look straight at his glowing heart for double damage.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.aan.hart: The Wahoog Altar glows: the bosses of the Heart of the Tree turn Wahoog (seal: %s). For half an hour, or until Baron Bleu flees.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.aan.werf: The Wahoog Altar glows: the bosses of the Cheese Zeppelin Yard turn Wahoog (seal: %s). For half an hour, or until Captain Roquefort falls.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.loopt: Wahoog mode is already running (seal: %s), %s min left.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vahoeg.uitleg: The Wahoog Altar. Place a Wahoog Seal on it (right-click with a seal in your bag, from lv 50): the bosses get stronger, and they drop Golden Feathers. Weekly seal now: %s.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vast.kamer: Locked in the Ripening Room! Click or press shift, or have a teammate sneak next to you.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vast.klauw: The Canopy Raptor grabs you! Click or press shift to wriggle free, or have your team hit it!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vast.wortel: A root has you in a stranglehold! Click or press shift, or have a teammate sneak next to you.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.veer.al: You already have the Golden Plumeguh. Just keep your feathers for show.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.veer.nog: Golden Feathers: %s / %s. With 25 you get the Golden Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.beschut: The nest branch catches the howl... and creaks.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.duik: He dives at the egg! Stand TOGETHER in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.ei_grauw: He skims past the egg. It turns grayer...
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.enrage.onder: The egg can't hold out much longer
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.hoogvads: Wahoognir blows a long pink beam of light across the horizon. Where it ends, a city floats above the clouds: Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.huil: CRYSTAL HOWL! Hide behind a big nest branch!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.klodder_ei: A gray bloblet rolls against the egg. The egg turns a little gray...
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.pluis: Black fluff rains down! Cheer up the gray bloblets before they reach the egg!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.remt: The egg glows pink! He slows down... and hesitates.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.splinter1.onder: A pink circle under his chest: put the first splinter back
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.splinter_cirkel: Stand in the pink circle under his chest for 3 s: put a heart splinter back!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.splinter_eerst: He waits... put a heart splinter back first (pink circle)!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.vn.te_hoog: He's flying too high. Protect the egg!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.volgorde: %s isn't showing up yet. Defeat %s first.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.werf.loods_open: BOOM! The cannons blast the gate open!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.werf.net: A rope safety net catches you and flings you back to the entrance of the yard.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.wortelwurger.onder: A tangle of gray roots around a rotten core
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ww.gekapt: A feeding root has been chopped through! (%s of 4)
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ww.grijp: Gray roots shoot out of the wall! Out of the red strips!
vadsrijk.z3bazen.ww.verslagen: The Root Strangler falls apart into gray fluff. Somewhere in the wall, the heart beats more calmly.
vadsrijk.z3bazen.zegel.taai: Tough (a shield in the first phase)
vadsrijk.z3imker.bom: He throws the big cheese smoke bomb! Everyone take cover in the yellow circle by the hive!
vadsrijk.z3imker.bom.mis: Too few by the hive: the cheese smoke hits everyone!
vadsrijk.z3imker.bom.ok: The queen spreads her wings: together you hold out.
vadsrijk.z3imker.fase2.onder: He's pouring gray honey into the hive. Turn the hive toward him!
vadsrijk.z3imker.fase3.onder: All or nothing. Take cover by the queen!
vadsrijk.z3imker.gestoken: Hit! The bees sting the Mika. Now you can hit him!
vadsrijk.z3imker.giet: He climbs onto a perch and pours gray honey into the hive...
vadsrijk.z3imker.grauw.onder: Turn the hive toward the Mika before it happens again!
vadsrijk.z3imker.immuun: He's pouring and can't be hit anywhere! Turn the hive so the bees sting him.
vadsrijk.z3imker.intro.0: In the comb hall stands a Mika in a way-too-big beekeeper suit, a smoke pot in one paw and a tin can in the other. A pin gleams on his suit: a little crown with a cheese hole. The Emperor's sign.
vadsrijk.z3imker.intro.1: "Nothing going on! Just... tasting honey. Quality control. For the report."
vadsrijk.z3imker.intro.2: "Gray honey? It's just RIPE. Like cheese. When the queen is gray, all the honey in Honeybough gets ripe. The Emperor likes ripe."
vadsrijk.z3imker.intro.3: Behind him the bee queen sits in her hive, gray and silent. The buzzing in the hall suddenly sounds very angry.
vadsrijk.z3imker.intro.4: "You found my clues? All five? Then you go in the report too. Under 'pesky'."
vadsrijk.z3imker.intro.5: "Smoke pots on! Bees, ATTACK! ...Bees? Hello? I'm the beekeeper!"
vadsrijk.z3imker.korf.gedraaid: The hive turns. Its hole points another way now.
vadsrijk.z3imker.na.0: The Mika Beekeeper flees up through the hatch in a cloud of cheese smoke. He drops his notebook.
vadsrijk.z3imker.na.1: "Report to the Emperor. Honeybough: make gray. Then: the Tree. Then: lunch."
vadsrijk.z3imker.na.2: The rest of the notebook is a drawing of a cheese. A very nice cheese, it must be said.
vadsrijk.z3imker.na.3: In the hive, the queen shakes the gray off her wings. She's golden again. And then... she sings. The whole comb hall hums along.
vadsrijk.z3imker.na.4: A tiny golden bee lands on your nose and won't leave. Bumble has picked you.
vadsrijk.z3imker.na.5: Take the good news to the Comb Weaver.
vadsrijk.z3imker.pot.laden: The smoke pot is still smoldering: %s more seconds.
vadsrijk.z3imker.pot.rook: Pfff... a thick cloud of smoke. It makes the bees drowsy.
vadsrijk.z3imker.puf: He points his smoker at you! Step aside!
vadsrijk.z3imker.tip.korf: Right-click the hive to turn its hole a sixth of a turn (shift + right-click = back). Every 6 seconds the hive shoots a stream of bees along the red lane. If that lane points at the Mika, the bees sting HIM.
vadsrijk.z3imker.tip.rook: Right-click a smoke pot: a cloud of smoke for 8 seconds. An angry swarm that flies through the smoke falls asleep. No bee stings you in the smoke.
vadsrijk.z3imker.titel.onder: The Emperor's spy. Beekeeper in name only.
vadsrijk.z3imker.weer_weg: The Mika Beekeeper has fled again. The queen hums happily.
vadsrijk.z3imker.zeg.au: OW! Not me! I'M the beekeeper!
vadsrijk.z3imker.zeg.fase2: Time for a top-up! A splash of ripe cheese honey for Her Majesty.
vadsrijk.z3imker.zeg.fase3: Enough! The big smoke pot! Everybody drowsy, except me!
vadsrijk.z3imker.zeg.vlucht: This is going in my report! With three exclamation marks!
vadsrijk.z3imker.zeg.weer: You again?! I was just... tasting. For the report.
vadsrijk.z3imker.zwerm: An angry swarm buzzes after %s! Lead it through the smoke!
vadsrijk.z3imker.zwerm.suf: The swarm gets drowsy in the smoke and falls asleep.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.alle: All five clues point to the hatch at the bottom of the Comb Clusters. The hatch is ajar!
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.grauwe_honing: A jar at the market is full of gray honey. The label says: 'Ripe Cheese Honey. Not for guhs.'
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.imkerpak: On a gangplank in Honeybough, a beekeeper suit hangs on the clothesline. With holes for ears. Pointy ears. And a tail.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.koningin: The bee queen doesn't sing anymore. She sits gray and silent in her comb. Something has made her sad.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.luik: At the bottom of the Comb Clusters there's a hatch with a little cat paw on it. Behind it, something buzzes angrily. And a voice squeaks: 'Meow. Do not disturb.'
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.rookpotjes: Next to the quest board lie three broken smoke pots. They smell like old cheese. Beekeepers never use cheese in their smoke.
vadsrijk.z3npc.aanwijzing.teller: Beekeeper clues found: %s of %s. Comb Weaver Waxy will surely want to know!
vadsrijk.z3npc.bam.aanval: Leaf Bandits on Blossom Square! Defeat them!
vadsrijk.z3npc.bevel: A Mika Command hangs on the jetty: "Find the egg. Let it ripen. Bring it to the Count. The Count brings it to Him."
vadsrijk.z3npc.duister.klopje: Beneath the beat of the heart you hear something else. A second little beat. Softer. Faster. The egg is still alive!
vadsrijk.z3npc.gezweefd: You're gliding! Your Plumeguh spreads its feathery ears and you drift gently down.
vadsrijk.z3npc.gids.start: Stable Master Feathers hops onto her Plumeguh: "Follow me! Up the bridle path, round and round the trunk, all the way to the top of canopy 1!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.af: All aboard! The honeycomb cabin slowly sinks down along the trunk, to Mossfoot.
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.dicht: The Honey Lift is still stuck. Beemother Combsy has the key to the lock...
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.op: All aboard! The honeycomb cabin whooshes up along the trunk, to Honeybough.
vadsrijk.z3npc.honinglift.open: Somewhere below, a chain rattles. The Honey Lift between Honeybough and Mossfoot works again!
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.open: At the bottom of the Comb Clusters you hear buzzing... and someone very quietly saying "ow, ow, ow".
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.0: In the comb hall stands a Mika in a way-too-big beekeeper suit, a smoke pot in one hand and a spoon in the other.
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.1: "Nothing going on! Just... tasting honey. For the report. Quality control!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.2: "What? Gray honey? Nope, it's just a little... ripe. Like cheese. Mikas like ripe."
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.3: The bees buzz angrily around his head. The smoke pot sputters, coughs out one little cloud and goes out.
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.4: "Okay, okay! I'm going! This is going in my report!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.imker.scene.5: He flees through the hatch with a full jar of honey. In his hurry, he leaves the jar behind. The bees are happy again.
vadsrijk.z3npc.ketel.uit: You close the mold tap. The kettle hisses, sputters and goes quiet. The valley gets a little of its color back.
vadsrijk.z3npc.kuiken.gevonden: Plume chick found! It squeaks happily. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z3npc.lichtje.gevonden: A Tree Folk light wakes up and blinks at you. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z3npc.nestlantaarn.0: Halfway there, knight. Here, take this. The Nest Lantern of the Tree Folk.
vadsrijk.z3npc.nestlantaarn.1: Under the floor it's pitch dark. In the light of this lantern, nothing can hide. Not even a count.
vadsrijk.z3npc.piepje.0: Between the combs sits a skinny little squeak-squeak mouse. It has lost its winter fur, and it's shivering.
vadsrijk.z3npc.piepje.1: Squeak... the Count... the cold... squeak.
vadsrijk.z3npc.piepje.2: The little mouse crawls into your bag, curls up and falls asleep. It doesn't want to leave.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.alle: Together, all eight reliefs tell the story of the nest and the egg. The Tree Folk knew everything. And the last relief... that mist, all the way from the east.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_1: A dragon, pink and big, circles above a teeny tiny tree. The tree grows.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_2: The tree is gigantic. In the canopy, the dragon builds a nest. Little wooden creatures wave.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_3: An egg, pink and glowing, in the nest. The Tree Folk dance around it with lanterns.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_4: A gray cloud comes from the east. The dragon flies at it. He is very angry. Or very scared.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_5: The dragon comes back. Gray. A splinter sticks out of his chest. He growls at his own egg.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_6: The Tree Folk carry the egg down, into the trunk, deep beneath the roots.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_7: The Tree Folk sit in a circle and fall asleep. Their lights grow softer. The egg glows.
vadsrijk.z3npc.relief.relief_8: A cat with a little crown, far away at the edge of the wall. Gray mist comes from his side, all the way to the nest. His reach is long.
vadsrijk.z3npc.ring.aan: Ring %s of the Lantern Tower is lit! The little cage springs open and the mice scurry down, squeaking.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.aankomst: Welcome to Honeybough! Beemother Combsy is waiting on Blossom Square, on the south side of the ring deck.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.bam.onder: A Mika zeppelin above the market!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.bam.pamflet: A flyer flutters down. And Leaf Bandits jump out of the zeppelin!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.bam.verstop: The guhs dart into their hive houses and shut the little hatches. Nobody gets hit!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.cliff.oosten: Far in the east, where the pink beam ended, a city floats above the clouds. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.ei.nep: The egg in Baron Bleu's room? Fake! A cheese wheel with pink paint. The real egg was safe here all along.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.ei.onder: Warm, pink, and it has a heartbeat
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.ei.warm: You pick up the egg. It's warm. The little heartbeat speeds up for a moment.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.afdruk: Silence. A gray, cold frost stain stays behind on the bark. As big as a door.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.cape: The cape falls to pieces. Count Squeakula stands there in his undershirt: "My cape! Do you know how many winters that took?!"
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.floep: Two Mikas step out of the mist. They grab the Count by his undershirt and drag him off into the mist. Poof. Gone.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.kraak: It's getting cold. Gray mist creeps in through a knothole in the wall of the Fur Hall.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.nee: "No no no, Emperor, I can explain! It was the knight! It was..."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f1.piepje: Squeaky crawls out of your bag and nudges something shiny toward you: the pin from the cape.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.krabbel_1: A teeny tiny Mika with a way-too-big quill pen reads aloud: "Report from the west."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.onder: Far in the east, something wants more and more.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.stem: A slow voice: "Then... I... reach... further."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.tik: From the shadow behind the throne comes impatient tapping on an armrest. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Against the light: a little crown, much too small.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.f2.zaal: Somewhere far away. A gray hall, thin light. Count Squeakula kneels in his undershirt, shivering.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.ei: Wahoognir curls his head around the nest. A dragon egg only hatches when the parent can keep it warm...
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.giechel: Wahoognir giggles. A giggling dragon makes the whole canopy shake.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.nies: Crack! Out rolls a teeny tiny pink dragon. It sneezes right away.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.roze: The black fluff blows off him like dandelion seeds. Fluffy wings, guh ears, pink. He's himself again.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.schouder: The little dragon sees you first, and climbs onto your shoulder. Wahoogie!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.splinters: You hold up the last splinter. All five float together into one pink heart crystal, and slide into his chest.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.straal: Wahoognir blows a long pink beam of light across the horizon, to the east. Where it ends, a city floats above the clouds.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.finale.weg: He looks at you, bows his head, and flies off after the beam.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.gekraak: Deep in the roots, two gray-blue eyes open. Something creaks: "He's still alive... but not for much longer."
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.kruin: The ship breaks through the clouds. The canopy is bathed in gold.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.nest.ei: ...and lays a glowing egg. He wraps his wings around it protectively.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.nest.leeg: The nest is enormous. Gray feathers, and a few pink ones in between. In the middle: an empty egg hollow.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.nest.vroeger: You picture it: Wahoognir, still pink, landing in his nest...
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.opening.onder: A tree as big as a mountain
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.nest: The wind columns blow you upward, canopy after canopy. The old nest! You lay the egg in the egg hollow. Then he lands: enormous, gray, crackling with black fluff.
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.onder: Out of the Root Tunnel and up the bridle path
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.schudt: The tree is shaking! Branches fall, bark tears. Wahoognir crashes through the canopy!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.rit.zweef: Round and round the trunk, past Honeybough, through the leaf tunnel. The dragon skims along the bark!
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.schors: A wall of bark slides past the airship. It doesn't stop. It just keeps going up and up...
vadsrijk.z3npc.scene.zwaaien: On a ring deck around the trunk, beekeeper guhs wave their veils. Honeybough!
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.moeras: On the east edge of the island, by the Honey Swamp, stands a chest. Sticky, but full.
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.nesttop: Among the branches of the old nest, at the very top of the tree, lies a forgotten chest. Nobody has ever made it this high.
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.onder_de_tak: At the very tip of the Southwest Bough, a chest hangs in a nest. Only the brave make it here!
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.schorsstad: In a little house high in the trunk wall stands a chest of the Tree Folk. There's still light inside.
vadsrijk.z3npc.schat.wortelduister: Behind a root pillar in the root hall, where only the mice ever went, lies a chest.
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.cape: The pin from Count Squeakula's cape. The biggest splinter so far.
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.nest: It lay among the branches of his old nest, next to his egg.
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.wachter: "I kept this warm for him. The little heart of his heart."
vadsrijk.z3npc.splinter.werf: In a little box with a bow: 'For the Count, for his collection.'
vadsrijk.z3npc.thee: Here you go, a cup of honey tea. Careful, it's hot. And sweet. Very sweet.
vadsrijk.z3npc.thee.al: You just had one! Drink up first, then you get another.
vadsrijk.z3npc.vahoegnir.zonder: Wahoognir lands by the nest, gray and crackling. You hold up the splinters...
vadsrijk.z3npc.vingerafdruk: A gray frost stain in the bark, as big as a door. Cold, and it smells of nothing. Professor Fluff would want to stare at this for a week.
vadsrijk.z3npc.vlek.schoon: Your Plumeguh shakes blossoms out of its plume. The gray patch turns green and pink again!
vadsrijk.z3npc.zone3.klaar: The dragon is pink again and the egg has hatched! The Duskroot blooms again. (Highchonk is coming soon.)
vadsrijk.z3wezens.cmd.alle: %s creatures lined up in a row.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.cmd.spawners: %s zone 3 spawners; max alive per layer: %s
vadsrijk.z3wezens.contract.vertrokken: %s has vanished again. Take the contract again at the Hunt Board.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.mika.weg.0: This is going in my report!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.mika.weg.2: The Count will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.mika.weg.3: I'll be back! With more cheese!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.set.bloesem.4: (4) Pollen: your critical hits make the creature Spored
vadsrijk.z3wezens.set.schors.4: (4) Resin Shield: when you drop below 50%% Chonk, you get a resin shield (1x per 30 s)
vadsrijk.z3wezens.set.wortel.4: (4) Rootlight: you give off light yourself in the Rootdark and deal +10%% to rot creatures
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.bijtbloesem: Not every flower is sweet. It doesn't walk away: from a distance you're safe. Yellow cone = pollen.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.bladrover: A red line toward you = his grappling hook. Step out of the line, or he pulls you over to him.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.donker: Outside the light you only see a shadow, and your hits do only half as much. Fight in the light of your Nest Lantern or by the pink veins!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.dove_ziener: He's blind but hears everything. Sneak (shift) up to him: your first hit then does double.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.grauwe_rups: Is it curling up? Step aside! After rolling it's dizzy for a moment: that's when you do extra damage.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.grauwe_wesp: One swarm, one health bar. Hits that strike several creatures at once work best here.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.harsgolem: Stay out of the red circle! If a pink crystal breaks out of its back, hit it from behind: x1.5.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.kaasschutter: The red line is where his cheese ball will go. Run up to him: up close he runs away.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.lantaarnloze: Does he blow out the light? Click him to light his lantern again: then he stands still for a moment.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.mika_schimmelboer: His mold fields make you Spored. Defeat him and his fields vanish with him.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.rotzwijn: Is it pawing the ground? Then it charges along the red line. Step aside and let it slam into a wall.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.schimmelbolletje: Small, but it puffs spores. Go for the mold farmer first!
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.schorskruiper: That bark moved! Bark Creepers jump out of the wall when you get too close. Watch out for their web.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.schorsmarter: They come in pairs and jump on you from above. Red circle = that's where it lands.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.wortelschim: In the dark it sneaks up behind you. Stay in the light, then you see it and hit it properly.
vadsrijk.z3wezens.tip.wortelslang: A dust trail toward you = it's coming up underneath you. Hit it when it's above ground!
